text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though Eishin Flash gets off to a smooth 
start, she appears to have something on 
her mind.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her peers this year were all high-profile 
talents. To secure results in the Classic 
Triple Crown races, she prudently decided 
to take on the Keisei Hai first.
